name: oakle
description: A daily Pokemon challenge: beat Professor Oak (Yellow) or Professor Elm (Crystal) with a new random party each day. One try a day.
author: Sam Stokes

scripts.deploy: npm run rom && npm run days && vite build && sh scripts/wrangler.sh deploy
scripts.rom: sh rom/build.sh && sh rom/crystal/build.sh && sh rom/emerald/build.sh && node scripts/gen-share.cjs && node scripts/gen-sprites.cjs
